This guide focuses on the `s_*` style primitives, how to declare named styles with `add_style()`, and recommended patterns for combining and applying styles. For runnable reporting examples see [Reporting Examples](Reporting_Examples_with_ksTFL.Rmd).

## Quick reference (primitives)

- `s_font(font_name, font_size, bold, italic, underline, color, highlight)`
- `s_paragraph(alignment, spacing = s_spacing(...), indents = s_indents(...))`
- `s_spacing(before, after, line_spacing)`
- `s_indents(left, right, first_line)`
- `s_table_style(background_color, row_height, vertical_alignment, text_orientation, borders = s_borders(...))`
- `s_borders(top, bottom, left, right)` and `s_border(color, width, line_style)`

Use these primitives inside `add_style()` only. The helpers validate parameter names and value patterns and will raise informative errors via `cli_abort()` if inputs are invalid.

## Declaring and applying styles

```r
spec <- create_table(mtcars)

spec <- spec |> add_style("title_header_style",
  s_font(font_name = "Arial", font_size = "12pt", bold = TRUE),
  s_paragraph(alignment = "center", spacing = s_spacing(before = "6pt", after = "6pt")),
  s_table_style(background_color = "#F2F2F2")
)

spec <- spec |> add_style("numeric_right", s_paragraph(alignment = "right"))

spec <- spec |> define_cols(c(mpg, hp), labelStyleRef = "title_header_style", valueStyleRef = "numeric_right")
```

## Combining styles (`f_combine()`)

`f_combine("styleA", "styleB")` returns a character vector of style names. `create_report()` consolidates combinations into a single merged style (order-independent) and writes the merged style into `spec$attribs$styles` under a hash name.

## Allowed enumerations (common)

- Font names: Arial, Courier New, Times New Roman, Calibri
- Alignment: left, right, center, justify, distributed
- Border styles: single, double, dashed, dotted, thick, none
- Vertical alignment: top, center, bottom
- Text orientation: horizontal, vertical_90, vertical_270

## Troubleshooting

- Context errors: ensure `s_*` helpers are only used inside `add_style()`.
- Style combinations not applied: call `create_report()` to force consolidation.

See `?add_style`, `?s_font`, and `?f_combine` for full parameter docs.
